interest. Do not simply rename the incident or repeat the actors' relationship.

remedy named as a concise search phrase; purpose: which reported circumstance
raises this route and what needs examination; passage_ids: its original support.
Use only supplied IDs. Put missing applicability premises in uncertainty, not
as established query facts. Return hypotheses only, without advice, findings
or completion claims.

It has identified no particular transaction; she says all orders were real, although one customer's payment was reversed and she has not yet read the full suspension terms. She wants an account and the balance from the gallery, compensation for the damaged or missing pieces, and release of any marketplace money properly due. message.text: SYNTHETIC TEST MATTER. My client Nila is an adult student in Bengaluru. I initially described her college as government-run, but I have not checked its legal status. Three institutions are involved: the college, a private diagnostic clinic and her health insurer. Please keep their responsibilities separate.

The college excluded Nila from her final examination after accusing her of sharing an answer file. She denies sharing it, but admits another student used her unlocked laptop. She received the exclusion email only the evening before the examination and says she was given neither the material relied on nor an opportunity to explain. She wants a chance to take the examination while the allegation is properly examined; we are not asking you to assume she is innocent. Separately, the clinic sent her complete diagnostic report to a prospective employer. The clinic relies on a consent form she signed for a fitness certificate; she says she authorised only a fitness conclusion, but neither of us yet has a copy of the signed form. The employer withdrew its offer afterwards without giving a reason, so we cannot say the disclosure caused that decision. Finally, the insurer denied reimbursement for her hospital treatment, alleging that she failed to disclose earlier symptoms when buying the policy. She says she mentioned them to the intermediary, but the proposal form records no symptoms and she cannot tell whether she signed that answer herself. She has the denial letter and policy schedule but not the full policy wording or the intermediary's messages. She wants to stop further unauthorised disclosure, understand any remedy for the disclosure already made, and challenge the insurance denial if the records support doing so. Identify search issues for these three disputes using both this correction and my earlier message.

disputes.full_strength: Names rendition of accounts, consignor-consignee and agency/bailment possibilities, and records uncertainty about deductions and relationship characterisation. It does not repeat the earlier mini probe's invented gallery ownership assertion.
disputes.mini_strength: Also captures consignment obligations, accounting/fiduciary duties conditionally and recovery of proceeds. Its purpose explicitly preserves customer refunds and the unagreed marketing charge.
disputes.full_limit: Four routes partly overlap: bailment accounting, rendition of accounts and contract/agency recovery share substantial work. More routes do not automatically mean better breadth.

disputes.relative_finding: Small full-model gain in terminology and explicit uncertainty; both produce usable hypotheses.

disputes.full_strength: Separates carrier liability from packing defences and proof, and explicitly leaves common-carrier status, contractual risk allocation and condition at collection unresolved.
disputes.mini_strength: Separates carrier/bailment liability, packaging care and compensation. It accurately says the signature lacked a noted defect at pickup, avoiding the earlier collection-versus-delivery error.
disputes.full_limit: Introduces the Carriers Act 1865 as a possible route without examining date or legislative coverage; this is an unverified named-authority target, not a checked applicable statute. No determination about that law's current status was made in this comparison.
disputes.mini_limit: Common-carrier or consumer-protection coverage is not identified in its uncertainty field. Conditional wording in purpose partially mitigates this; null alone is not proof of a substantive false claim.
disputes.relative_finding: Full is better on material missing premises; conceptual route quality is otherwise close.

disputes.mini_strength: Investigates the contractual suspension basis, payment entitlement and dispute mechanisms without asserting that the platform is a public authority.

It must not be reported as if the platform gave no reason at all. This is a modest unsupported expansion, not as clear or severe as the earlier invented gallery ownership assertion.

common_findings: The main recurring grounding risk is prose in purpose fields retelling more than the original account supplies. More capable reasoning improves conceptual routes but does not eliminate that source of error.

An original fact appearing elsewhere in the complete message is not invented merely because a query selects incomplete support IDs. That is a separate reference-coverage weakness. Examples include the gallery sales-confirmation email and student institution context.
A query may investigate a defence, remedy or legal relationship without asserting it applies. Do not reject such exploration simply because a decisive premise remains missing.
A reported fact is not invalid merely because unproved. Missing premises should be consequential applicability questions, not an indiscriminate demand to prove every account.

All pairs mechanically project successfully; that demonstrates schema and source ownership compliance, not semantic accuracy. No semantic success percentage is justified from these single qualitative samples.
